items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: at that time the Sudanese were the police, Sudanese was a man about seven feet tall, and they had them swords, those long swords.

ctx.x: Antinurse, it's a French word, so Chitteson had been going down there and it looked pretty good down there, and we got into the booth and Chitteson was -- there was another tall one, redheaded girl, she liked me. She liked me very much. All the girls were from Germany and I could speak German, so we was making it pretty good, but Chitteson seemed to have a problem, so Chitteson decided that he would take this girl's pocketbook and go home with it and the girl would follow him up to his room.

I said, Chitteson, what are you doing. He said, oh, this woman likes me and she'll be up soon. At 5:00 that morning I was asleep inbed, at that time the Sudanese were the police, Sudanese was a man about seven feet tall, and they had them swords, those long swords. The sword was as tall as Chitteson, and if you did anything, he wouldn't hesitate.
